usedFor: ClickBank sends the sale and Google Contacts keeps the buyer, so “New Transaction Postback” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transaction Postback” in ClickBank, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Every sale postback adds the buyer to your address book without anyone copying details across.

watchOut: “New Transaction Postback” also fires for impressions and upsells, so filter events or you may add one buyer twice.
